text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place Health and Safety program, specifically on activities, priorities, and overall health and safety performance for the year ending 2025. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for 2025 were $6,110.60 lower than in 2024. The lower fees are attributable to a proactive return-to-work program that supports safe and timely reintegration of workers into the workplace.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (April 3, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
